name: Sign in and preserve a research source
description: An authenticated researcher can save a complete source and edit its metadata without losing it on refresh.
steps: Sign in through the workspace sign-in flow
Open New source and create a source titled 'QA Research Source' with author 'QA Scientist', year '2026', and DOI '10.1234/qa'
Open its detail inspector and confirm metadata appears
Edit its title to 'QA Research Source Revised' and save
Refresh; confirm revised title and DOI remain in Research library
expected: The edited source persists in the authenticated workspace with its bibliographic fields.

name: Create claims and connect evidence
description: Sources and claims can be connected in a traceable graph.
steps: Sign in
Create a source titled 'Graph Study'
Create a claim titled 'Graph Test Claim' with an explanation
Open Knowledge graph and choose Connect nodes
Connect Graph Study to Graph Test Claim with relationship 'supports'
Confirm the relationship appears and click Graph Test Claim to inspect it
expected: Knowledge graph contains the source, claim, and supports relationship, and the claim inspector opens.

name: Track and export a hypothesis
description: Researchers can maintain an explicit judgment separate from verified evidence and export records.
steps: Sign in
Create hypothesis titled 'QA Hypothesis' with 35% confidence and status 'investigating'
Open its detail and verify status and confidence
Edit status to 'contested' and confidence to 20%, then save
Export JSON from header, and CSV from Hypotheses screen
expected: Hypothesis shows contested with 20% confidence and exports contain the research record.

name: Mobile required-title validation
description: A blank research source cannot be saved and validation appears on mobile.
steps: Sign in on mobile viewport
Tap New source
Leave Title blank and tap Create record
Observe the validation error
Close the form and confirm no blank source appeared
expected: A visible title-required validation appears, and no blank source is created.

name: Confirm deletion and remove graph connections
description: Deleting a source requires confirmation and removes its linked visual relationships.
setup: Sign in and create source 'Source To Delete'
Connect Source To Delete to Claim For Deletion with supports relation
steps: Open Research library and inspect Source To Delete
Select Delete and cancel the confirmation; verify source remains
Select Delete again and confirm
Refresh and open Knowledge graph
expected: Deleted source is absent after refresh and its supports relationship no longer appears in the graph.
